question: 2-Methylpropan-2-ol is commonly known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**tert-butyl alcohol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **tert-butyl alcohol** is the common name for 2-Methylpropan-2-ol.
 
• It is a tertiary alcohol with the chemical formula (CH₃)₃COH.
 
• The structure of tert-butyl alcohol consists of a central carbon atom bonded to three methyl groups and one hydroxyl group.
 
• This alcohol is used in various industrial applications including as a solvent and an intermediate in chemical synthesis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 2-Methylpropan-2-ol can also be referred to as **trimethyl carbinol**.
 
• It is a colorless solid at room temperature but melts to a liquid slightly above room temperature.
 
• tert-Butyl alcohol is flammable and has a camphor-like odor.
 
• It is miscible with water, ethanol, and diethyl ether.
 
• In organic chemistry, tert-butyl alcohol is often used as a protecting group for alcohols.
